RECOMMENDATION FOR REWARDS, ADVANCEMENT

F. I. R. No. .................................... or File No. ....................................

Summary of case or cases and recommendations by Officer i/c District or Senior Detective.

Good and consistent work by D.S. Medvedeff for
period January 1 to June 30, 1936.

I beg respectfully to draw attention to the good
work performed by D.S. Medvedeff during the above
mentioned period. He has shown consistent tact,
reliability and intelligence in carrying out his
duties in the supervision of licensed boarding houses
and has submitted approximately 50 reports on the
movements of Foreign criminals and/or suspects,
not a few of whom were located, despite their use
of aliases. Such information as submitted by the
officer in question added greatly to the effectiveness
of this Section.

In addition I have to state that the registers
of boarding houses show a great improvement in the
manner of their compilation, which reflects credit
on D.S. Medvedeff especially when it is considered
that the operators of boarding houses in the Northern
and Eastern Districts, of which he is in charge, for
the purpose of supervision, consist of ignorant and
low class persons, to say nothing of that element
which is deliberately obstructive to enquiries by the
Police.

由辖区主管警官或高级侦探提交的案件摘要及推荐意见。

警佐梅德韦杰夫（Medvedeff）在 1936 年 1 月 1 日至 6 月 30 日期间工作良好且一贯稳定。

本人谨提请注意警佐梅德韦杰夫在上述期间所做出的良好工作表现。他在监管持牌寄宿公寓的职责履行中，表现出了一贯的机智、可靠和聪慧，并提交了约 50 份关于外国罪犯及/或嫌疑人行踪的报告，其中不少人尽管使用化名，仍被查明下落。该警官所提交的情报极大地增强了本组的工作效能。

此外，本人须指出，寄宿公寓登记册在编制方式上有了很大改进，这为警佐梅德韦杰夫赢得了荣誉，尤其是考虑到他所负责监管的北区和东区寄宿公寓经营者均由无知且下层的人员组成，更不必说那些故意阻碍警方调查的不法分子了。

（左侧手写批注：）
监视
记录于 1936 年 1 月 20 日。

冷登（Colden）巡官
情报组
7 月 20 日。

虽然我对警佐梅德韦杰夫令人满意地履行职责感到高兴，但遗憾的是，我无法将他的案例提交董事会审议，因为这不符合现行关于非英籍工部局警务处官员的部门主管条例规定。
